title: 酬乐天扬州初逢席上见赠
titlePy: Chóu Lètiān Yángzhōu Chū Féng Xí Shàng Jiàn Zèng
titleEn: Replying to Bai Juyi, Who Gave Me a Poem at Our First Meeting in Yangzhou
author: 刘禹锡
intro: After twenty-three years of exile, Liu Yuxi meets his friend Bai Juyi at a banquet and answers his poem. It starts in bitterness — and then turns into one of the most hopeful couplets in Chinese: past the sunken boat, a thousand sails go by.
analysis: 公元826年，刘禹锡结束了长达二十三年的贬谪生活，回洛阳途中在扬州遇到了白居易（字乐天）。白居易在酒席上写诗送他，替他的遭遇抱不平，刘禹锡就写了这首诗回赠。前四句写心中的悲凉：我被丢在巴山楚水这些荒凉地方，整整二十三年；怀念去世的老朋友，只能空吟《思旧赋》；回到家乡，像那个看棋烂了斧柄的王质，人事全非。这里用了两个典故（古书里的故事），把伤感说得很深。五六句忽然一转：沉没的船旁边，千万只帆船照样驶过；病树前面，万棵树木照样迎来春天。诗人把自己比作“沉舟”“病树”，却不悲观——个人的不幸挡不住世界向前，新事物总会蓬勃生长。最后两句说：今天听你唱了这首歌，就借这杯酒振作起精神吧。“沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春”今天常用来说新事物必然取代旧事物。
analysisEn: In 826 Liu Yuxi’s exile finally ended after twenty-three years. On his way north he met the poet Bai Juyi (courtesy name Letian) in Yangzhou. At a banquet Bai wrote a poem for him, lamenting how unfairly he had been treated, and Liu replied with this one. The first four lines are full of grief: I was thrown away in the wild lands of Ba and Chu for twenty-three years; remembering friends who have died, all I can do is recite an old lament for the departed; coming home, I am like the woodcutter in the legend who watched a game of chess in the mountains and found his axe handle rotted away — everything has changed. These two allusions (references to old stories) make the sadness run deep. Then the fifth and sixth lines turn sharply: beside the sunken boat, a thousand sails sail past; in front of the sick tree, ten thousand trees burst into spring. Liu calls himself the sunken boat and the sick tree — yet he isn’t bitter. One person’s misfortune cannot stop the world moving on, and new life will always flourish. The last couplet: hearing your song today, let this cup of wine lift my spirits. The famous couplet is still quoted today to say that the new will always replace the old.
background: Liu Yuxi (772–842) was exiled in 805 after a failed reform movement and spent most of the next twenty-three years in remote southern posts. He wrote this in 826, when he met Bai Juyi (772–846) in Yangzhou; the two became close friends and poetic partners for the rest of their lives.
pronunciation: “乐天”的“乐”读 lè；“弃置”的“置”读 zhì；“烂柯”的“柯”读 kē；“侧畔”读 cè pàn；“千帆过”的“过”读 guò；“长精神”的“长”读 zhǎng（增长）。“翻似”的“翻”是“反而”的意思，读 fān。
version: 采用通行教材版本。无重要异文。

lines.py: bā shān chǔ shuǐ qī liáng dì
lines.lit: The hills of Ba and the waters of Chu — desolate places;
lines.en: In the bleak hills and rivers of the far south

lines.py: èr shí sān nián qì zhì shēn
lines.lit: twenty-three years, a body cast aside.
lines.en: I lay discarded for twenty-three years.

lines.py: huái jiù kōng yín wén dí fù
lines.lit: Missing old friends, in vain I chant the “Hearing the Flute” rhapsody;
lines.en: Mourning old friends, I can only recite a lament;

lines.py: dào xiāng fān sì làn kē rén
lines.lit: reaching home, I am instead like the man whose axe handle rotted.
lines.en: home again, I’m a stranger, as if a hundred years had passed.

lines.py: chén zhōu cè pàn qiān fān guò
lines.lit: Beside the sunken boat, a thousand sails go past;
lines.en: Past the sunken boat a thousand sails go by;

lines.py: bìng shù qián tóu wàn mù chūn
lines.lit: in front of the sick tree, ten thousand trees in spring.
lines.en: beyond the sick tree, a whole forest greens in spring.

lines.py: jīn rì tīng jūn gē yī qǔ
lines.lit: Today, hearing you sing a song,
lines.en: Today I’ve heard your song, my friend —

lines.py: zàn píng bēi jiǔ zhǎng jīng shén
lines.lit: for now, relying on a cup of wine, I lift my spirits.
lines.en: let this cup of wine put heart in me again.

words.note: 古代用诗回赠别人叫“酬”；今天“酬”多指“报酬”“酬谢”。

words.en: Letian — courtesy name of Bai Juyi
words.note: 白居易字乐天；今天“乐天”也指乐观，如“乐天派”。

words.en: the hills of Ba and waters of Chu — remote southern lands
words.note: 巴：今重庆、四川东部；楚：今湖南、湖北。
现代汉语书面语“弃置不用”。

words.en: “Hearing the Flute”, an old lament for dead friends
words.note: 指晋代向秀的《思旧赋》：他路过亡友旧居，听见笛声，写赋怀念。
翻：反而。今天“翻”多指“翻书”“翻身”。

words.en: the man whose axe handle rotted — someone returning to a changed world
words.note: 传说王质进山看仙人下棋，一局未完，斧柄已烂，回村时人都换了几代。柯：斧柄。
现代汉语有成语“破釜沉舟”。

words.en: to rely on; by means of

words.note: 长：增长。今天说“提精神”“振作”。

imagery.name: 帆
imagery.zh: 沉船旁驶过的千帆，代表不断涌现的新生力量。
imagery.en: The thousand sails passing the wreck stand for new life that keeps coming.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 朋友相逢的一杯酒，帮诗人重新振作起来。
imagery.en: A cup of wine with an old friend helps the poet pull himself together again.

imagery.name: 笛
imagery.zh: “闻笛”指向秀听笛怀念亡友，诗人借此悼念那些已经去世的旧友。
imagery.en: “Hearing the flute” recalls an old lament for dead friends — Liu mourns the companions he lost during exile.
